mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of FEDFUNDS decreasing periods over a 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) rising above 8.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite UNRATE rising >0.4pp in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), higher discount rates reduce the present value of future equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive during a period classified as a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) increases interest rate expectations, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when CPIAUCSL increases over a 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in employment (PAYEMS below 130,000) signals recessionary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive when PAYEMS falls below 130,000 in the following month.

mechanism_narrative: When both demand (GDPC1) and labor (PAYEMS) increase in the same month, it indicates strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both increase in the same month
failure_condition: SPX returns negative when both GDPC1 and PAYEMS increase in the same month over a 4-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, simultaneous improvements in labor market conditions (UNRATE) and supply (INDPRO) signal economic expansion, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative during the post-recession recovery phase despite simultaneous improvements in UNRATE and INDPRO.
